summary: o-4874230a0858b6e9: the old harness cannot reach saved-comment handling.

assessment.necessity_reason: Saved comments are a supported mode of string parsing. A finite input such as "# comment\nx=1;" can reach comment saving when UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS is set. The fixed harness always constructs the parser with flags 0 and has no later configuration step, so input bytes cannot enable the mode or provide an equivalent route.

before.requirement: String parsing must be able to save and attach input comments when the parser is constructed with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS.
before.reason: The flag, guarded saving path, and attachment path existed before the change. The harness passes flags 0.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Comment input calls the saving helper only when the flag is set.
Parser construction copies the supplied flags and creates comment storage only in saved-comment mode.

after.requirement: String parsing must be able to save and attach input comments when the parser is constructed with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS.
after.reason: The guarded saving path remains, and the selected changes alter pending-comment handling and cleanup. The old harness still passes flags 0.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Comment input still calls the saving helper only when the flag is set.
Parser construction still gates comment storage on the supplied flags.
The second selected change adds cleanup for a saved comment left pending at parser destruction.

assessment.comparison_reason: On both source versions, the same fixed call to ucl_parser_new(0) prevents saved-comment mode. The changes to pending-comment handling do not change that harness constraint.
